acquisition.const: Copied the fixed audit snapshot locally, checked both encodings and pinned Git blob; the audit retained connector-decoded text and reversibly reconstructed GBK. No new download or independent executable extraction.

precondition.const: City pointer validation at 0049E59D passed and virtual40 owner result at 0049E5B1 is 0..46; helpers return normally preserving the nonvolatile-register and stack contract. These conditions are requirements, not callee certifications.

slots.const: Exactly 30 observations; null is a resolved zero result of pointer validator 0047A630 at 0049E5E7, never missing data

facilityTypeWord.const: U32 [facility+8] at 0049E5F7; dispatch uses (word-31) modulo 2^32 and an unsigned comparison to 20

constructionWord.const: U32 [facility+0x14] at the selected branch; every nonzero bit pattern means complete

resolvedTypeRows.const: One stable row per effective type; lookup 00490B90 and validator 0047A630 resolved externally; valid moneyYieldWord is U16 [row+0xC0] at 0049E63D

adjacentMint.const: Boolean of zero/nonzero return from 0049E500 at 0049E660 for this facility coordinate and type 0x26, consumed only after valid effective type 31/50/51; geometry and helper filters are not reconstructed

difficultyWord.const: U32 [07201978] at 0049E6B1; exactly 0 and 2 are special, all other word patterns use 100 percent

cityPlayerPredicate.const: Boolean of city virtual48 return at 0049E6C9, consumed only for difficultyWord equal to 2

securityByte.const: Late U8 [city+0x85] read at 0049E6FE, lower clamp 50 and no upper clamp 100

rawMoney.const: baseMoneyWord + sum(30 locally calculated slot contributions)

mintContribution.const: floor(3*moneyYieldWord/2) only for effective type 31/50/51 with adjacentMint true

difficultyPercent.const: 0 -> 125; 2 with player true -> 75; 2 with player false -> 125; every other U32 -> 100

const: difficultyProduct = scaledRaw*difficultyPercent only for difficultyWord 0 or 2; otherwise null
difficultyAdjusted = difficultyProduct/100 truncated toward zero if present; otherwise scaledRaw

safeDomain.const: Every actual scaledRaw, difficultyProduct (when present) and securityProduct must be <= 2147483647; inputs and products are nonnegative. Do not test a nonexistent rawMoney*100*100 product on ordinary difficulty.

overflowBehavior.const: unsupported-arithmetic-domain, no wrap, no saturation and no unbounded substitute result

const: c1 fa 05 decodes SAR EDX,5, not the listed SAR DL,5
83 fe ff decodes CMP ESI,-1, not a comparison to 255

conditionalObservationValidation.const: The schema encodes referenced-row presence, difficulty predicate and cross-row adjacentMint consumption. The runtime additionally validates arithmetic support and JavaScript data descriptors/prototypes without invoking accessors.

numericSemantics.const: Finite integral JSON numbers in the stated widths; booleans and strings are not numbers; no coercion or truncation; negative zero normalizes to zero.

typeScriptOutput.const: Deeply frozen scalar receipts; no mutable input references

pythonOutput.const: Fresh plain JSON dictionaries/lists and scalar integers; no mutable input references, but Python receipts are not frozen

rejectionOrder.const: top closed fields, profile, numeric widths, difficulty predicate, complete type-row structure, dense 30-slot array, each slot and its consumed observations in index order, arithmetic domain
